sections.body:
Most content mistakes are not creativity problems. They are checklist problems.

Our editorial checklist is simple:
Verify facts.
Retain qualifications.
Use plain language.
Review before publication.

Verify facts: if a detail matters, confirm it. If it cannot be confirmed, do not write as if it is true.

Retain qualifications: keep the “usually,” “in this context,” and “based on what we know” parts. Those words are not fluff, they are accuracy.

Use plain language: clarity is a quality bar. If a smart reader has to reread a sentence, rewrite it.

Review before publication: a final pass catches the easy misses, inconsistent wording, and accidental overclaims.

If you publish consistently, this kind of checklist is what keeps your credibility intact.
